outcome: umbilical artery pH in the second twin
cohort: The study analyzed 267 twin pregnancies at a single center.
finding: Induction of labor was associated with a doubled cesarean delivery rate and, along with nulliparity, increased the risk for cesarean delivery in both twins.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery doubled if induction of labor was necessary.
birth_weight: Estimated weight difference between twins <= 500 g (inclusion criteria for vaginal delivery)
